summary: Dense residential kerb, houses 1-9 m away and steep for most of its length.
reasons: Homes on both sides of street

best_section.where: Low point of Adsett Street, west kerb, about 80 m from the north end

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings at 8 m (at 69 and 91 m) and 1 m (at 105 m) on the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb, so room to stop exists.
drivers.convention: Cars park along it; signs include No Stopping and weekday No Parking.

flags: Steep overall: 14% mean, 23% max; flat only at 80-105 m
Dwellings within 10 m of best section
Signs: No Stopping Any Time and No Parking Mon-Fri 7am-6pm
sun_shade: Mixed tree cover, houses shade from the west; sun from the east.
